summary: Iteration 6 focused retest passed. All 4 backend pytest scenarios passed: exact 404 ownership guards for stock and booking photos with protected photos remaining active, explicit-null booking stock unlink plus omitted-field preservation, and requested stock/booking CRUD, invoice-photo, file-serving, and audit regressions. context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 fixes are verified against the public URL. Run test_iteration6_retest.py for focused regression. Auth cookie, CORS allowlist, brute-force lockout, and server.py length were explicitly out of scope and were not retested or re-flagged.
rca_of_the_issue: Verified fixes address the prior causes: both photo-delete handlers now validate membership in the scoped owner and bind the files update to owner id; update_booking records explicit stock_id=null intent before filtering other nulls; PhotoUploader disables against endpointBase, which becomes valid as soon as the newly created stock id is stored.
